alternate_mechanisms.name: concealed_relation_becomes_disclosed_truth
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Covering and disclosure are transferred into the social field. Veiled awareness suppresses another's need and one's own dependence; disclosed truth is remembered, publicly confirmed, and enacted as giving that actually supports.

alternate_mechanisms.name: created_capacity_becomes_acquired_course
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Creation provides measured form, disposition, aptitude, and an available share of good, but striving turns capacity into a trajectory. Generous action, protective discipline, and pliant readiness form the course that facilitation then makes traversable.

alternate_mechanisms.name: encounter_with_need_reveals_true_sufficiency
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Purposeful striving reaches another person and encounters petition or dependence. Giving responds with support that genuinely avails, exposing the difference between functional sufficiency shared in relation and a private claim to need no one.

alternate_mechanisms.name: property_as_measured_obligation
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Measured creation and taqwā supply a standard within which possession is handled. Giving can fulfill a right or obligation, whereas stinginess withholds property from where it is due; legal documents, exact quantities, and marriage contracts remain analogues rather than stated institutions.

alternate_mechanisms.name: guarded_gait_becomes_pliant_facilitation
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Taqwā regulates movement with caution, generosity crosses from intent into action, and relinquished resistance creates pliancy. Facilitation does not erase agency; it realizes a guarded and acquired readiness on a smooth, traversable course.

alternate_mechanisms.name: prosperity_is_not_the_definition_of_ease
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Material prosperity overlaps with one branch of ease, but the passage defines the easy course by recognized good, beneficent transfer, and support. Possession becomes morally adverse when it produces withholding and an isolating claim of self-sufficiency.

alternate_mechanisms.name: truthful_transfer_as_relational_household_analogue
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The highest-ranked marriage and dower cluster offers a bounded analogy: truthful transfer can establish an obligation-bearing relation in which support creates shared sufficiency. The passage does not identify giving with a dower, al-ḥusnā with marriage, or the moral courses with male and female.
